sections.text_helper: Section 14.8.3 "LPDMA masked interrupt status register (LPDMA_MISR)" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 423.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This is a read register.
A masked interrupt status bit MISx is asserted by hardware for each channel x. It is a logical
OR of all the LPDMA_CxSR flags, each source flag being enabled by the corresponding
LPDMA_CxCR interrupt enable bit.
Every bit is de-asserted by hardware when writing 1 to the corresponding LPDMA_CxFCR
flag clear bit.
This register can mix privileged and unprivileged information, depending on the privileged
state of each channel LPDMA_PRIVCFGR.PRIVx. A privileged software can read the full
interrupt status. An unprivileged software is restricted to read the status of unprivileged
channels, other privileged bit fields returning zero.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 MISx: masked interrupt status of channel x (x = 7 to 0)
0: no interrupt occurred on channel x
1: an interrupt occurred on channel x
